questions.question: What does the address-of operator & return when applied to a variable?
options: D. The size of the variable

questions.question: What is a NULL pointer?
options: A. A pointer that points to a valid integer
B. A pointer whose value represents no valid object address
C. A pointer that always points to address 1
D. A pointer to a string

C. They prevent the function from accessing memory
D. They convert all values to strings

questions.question: What does const int *p mean?
options: B. The int object accessed through p should not be modified through p
C. Both p and the int object can never change
D. p is a constant integer
